title: The KV pool as four shares, and what a reservation leaves unused
why: It shows the pool as one quantity divided up, which the prose describes in sequence: 262,144 positions split into four equal shares of 65,536, each trimmed by the reply budget and decode margin to an admitted ceiling of 32,750, with the rest reserved but idle.
note: One stream's reservation: 65,536 - 32,768 reply budget - 16 decode rows - 2 alignment = 32,750 admitted. The rest sits reserved until the stream ends.

panels.title: one share, trimmed
panels.note: A request that finishes early still held its whole share: internal fragmentation.
